author: daniellehrner
content:
It is definitely possible to seal an blocks within that time. I think your 2nd point is the core of the disagreement here. 

We should clarify the spec to what is expected here from the EL. 

Should we respond as fast as possible or can we try to build more valuable blocks, as long as we stay within the timeout limit?

author: potuz
content: I think the timeout is not there to produce better blocks, it's literally a deadline by which clients will give up and not propose. This latter point is no longer tire n Gloas as it's safe to propose without a local payload so that deadline can be made even more aggressively shorter.

author: potuz
content: I think we need to give more cause any lagging client for whatever reason will not be able to ever catch if a block takes more than 6s. We need the majority of nodes to execute in less than 6 second but we should be resilient on some nodes not being able
